memories.summary: Mara's flight to Lagos to visit her mother is booked for 2026-07-09; as of 2026-06-22 she is counting down, oscillating between excitement and bracing for impact.
Mara feels a guilty imbalance that her brother Chidi has carried their mother's care in Lagos for months while she only sent money and worried from abroad; Chidi is picking her up at the airport.
Mara told Priyanka the exact dates of her July Lagos trip and Priyanka was fine with it, leading Mara to think she may have misjudged her.

entities.name: Priyanka
entities.description: the charge nurse / manager at the General; distinct from Mara's friend Priya

memories.summary: Ahead of the July trip Mara braced (2026-06-22) for seeing her mother smaller than she remembered, the Lagos heat, the chaotic airport, and relatives asking when she and Daniel will marry.
Chidi is picking Mara up from the Lagos airport so she won't have to fight the taxi touts (planned as of 2026-06-22).
